8aa600.evidence: UNREACHABLE — no route exists. DNS resolves consistently to 44.228.249.3 (no AAAA) via local resolver, 8.8.8.8, and 1.1.1.1. TCP 80/443 connect times out from this sandbox (direct and via Caido proxy, which returns 502 cause=Timeout after its 10s upstream limit). nmap -Pn -T4 shows 0 open ports across 1-1024 plus 8080/8443/8000/8081/8888/3000/5000/9000. Aliases www.vulnweb.com and vulnweb.com resolve to the same IP and time out identically. Egress is NOT the cause: google.com, example.com, and AWS us-west-2 endpoints (s3/dynamodb/ec2) all connect fine. Multi-node external confirmation via check-host.net: all 12 global nodes (CA, ES, HK, IL, IR, IT, JP, RU x2, TR, UA, UK) report "Connection timed out" on TCP 443, and all 12 nodes (incl. US node us4) on TCP 80. Independent external fetchers also fail: r.jina.ai "upstream connect error ... connection termination", api.allorigins.win HTTP 408, api.codetabs.com HTTP 522. Conclusion: the origin server is globally down/filtered, not a local egress restriction. No working route (no alternate IPs, ports, hostnames, IPv6, or proxy path).
